== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Joy [[Icon]] is a specific type of [[Icon]] that manifests as a luminous violet flower. It serves several functions for its user, [[Mercy]], including providing her with the ability to sense the emotional states and intentions of those around her. The [[Icon]] also assists her in maintaining perspective during difficult times and can be used to infuse seeds with life. While it typically provides a warm, singing presence, its influence can diminish and become a faint whisper when faced with the hostility of the Void.}}
